channel.title: More than haunted house
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "More than haunted house" - My SCP is a building SCP. It has 5 floors, and something in each one.

item.title: Just a suggestion
item.content:encoded: I… well, I do like it. It just seems a tad cliche (as Ramses has pointed out). The floors representing different things are an interesting twist, though—perhaps you could make it a seven story house where each floor investigates each of the seven deadly sins?

item.title: Re: More than haunted house
item.content:encoded: The idea feels rather generic, and not very fleshed out. We've already got so many "weird buildings" (Infinite Ikea, Abandoned Row Home, the stairwell, etc) and these supposed anomalies aren't all that interesting. "Person that rips out your kidneys" is too vague and anyone who's been here more than a week would be too desensitized to find this scary, we've got at least three different zombie-related articles here already, and the fifth floor just feels like you skimmed a Lovecraft collection. There's no real hook here.

item.title: Re: More than haunted house
item.content:encoded:
I think you could explore a lot that idea!

First, instead of just floors, it could be that eat level could be a bend reality anomaly. Capturing people aroung the world in common places, like the subway, to a pocket dimension full of nightmares. Yo ucould put a level of mystery there, or be very specific, though I would recomend that higher the floor, higher the danger and the mystery.

One time inside it, people have to clear all floors to get out.

By capturing people around the world I think it increases a lot the threat for the foundation!

Hope you get the greenlight! Have a great day! :D

item.title: More than haunted house
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Elevator Pitch: A 5 story building full of horror, gore, and plain violence. You have to be careful in there or you might be jumped.

Central Narrative: My SCP is going to (hopefully) by SCP-5188. It is a 5 story building, the 5th floor is the roof. First floor: Night vision underworld (Dont put em on). Second floor: Friendly librarian (No catches). Third floor: Temptation. Fourth floor: The chair. 5th floor (Roof): Tentacles (And pocket dimension :D)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Building full of horror on almost each floor. Never let your guard down, and be very quiet.

Note: If you want the sandbox article for further critique, ask for it please.
